encoding: RFC 8785 (JCS) JSON, integers only; binary values standard base64 with padding; ids and digests lowercase hex

shapes.what: a key slot: the vault master key under one unlock method's secret
shapes.associated_data: the slot's JCS bytes without nonce and vmk
shapes.wrap: HKDF-SHA256(ikm = the method secret, salt = the slot id's 32 bytes, info = "openagents.vault.v1/slot" 0 method), then AES-256-GCM

shapes.what: a sealed object: OAVAULT1, be32(header length), the header, the chunks
shapes.associated_data: "openagents.vault.v1/chunk" 0 SHA-256(JCS(core)) for a chunk; "openagents.vault.v1/wrap-user" 0 the same digest for the user wrap
